opening.argument: The subject is a proposed Terra Luna token distribution and the disagreement it has created among current and previous holders. The speaker frames the discussion as market commentary, beginning, “But I want to talk about the token distribution.” The treatment of Luna is also expressly cautionary: buyers are described as “knowing that they are taking extreme risk buying into a dying project,” rather than being assured of profits. Although viewers are encouraged to consider taking a chance on Luna and are directed to Voyager, the stated $25 Bitcoin promotion is presented as a conditional exchange signup offer. Nothing in that offer promises Luna gains or conceals the risk the speaker has identified.
